title: Limits
content:
Limits

Friendly never means selling. These limits are product truth. Read them before you design a store around this stack.

Full list with issues: docs/guide/limits.md. Feature by tier: support matrix.

b-dosql

  • One Durable Object per site: one writer and one region.
  • About 5 uncached requests a second. Past that the queue grows. At about 100 clients the object refuses (perf-dosql.md).
  • WooCommerce on b-dosql is a light storefront. Cart, checkout, admin, and logged-in pages always run PHP.
  • Under load the isolate can reset and lose writes (#1022). Measured on cf759a: 43 resets and 49 lost writes per 1000 server requests (2026-11-22). A real store should use approach A.
  • How many plugins fit is a per-request memory limit on heavy admin pages.
  • Worker upload gate is 62 MiB uncompressed (platform 64 MiB). WooCommerce alone is about 58.3 MiB. Some large plugins do not fit the bundle (#279).

Approach A

  • Needs Workers Paid and external MySQL.
  • Cold isolates are slow on first request: 3 to 9 s more at the client (#1169).
  • Checkout time is mostly database time today (about 5 to 7 s after transient-delete batching; #1210, #1218).
  • WooCommerce admin screens and bulk product edits take seconds, not fractions of a second (#1078).
  • A guest product page that was not cached yet can be slow when the render runs far from the database (#1277, open).
  • One MySQL query may take at most 30 s by default (DB_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS; #1359).
  • A step-by-step MySQL start page is still open (#1365). Use onboarding and the deploy reference today.

Cache and stock

  • A cached product page can show an old stock number for up to about 30 s, or longer after a quiet spell (#628, #699).
  • Checkout always reads real stock, so it does not oversell.
  • Lamp operators: from-lamp.md has the WooCommerce setting that avoids exact stock on cached pages.

Plans and cost

  • Workers Free: b-dosql WordPress and light shop only. Approach A installer is refused. Editing a WooCommerce store does not fit Free memory (#638).
  • Workers Paid: $5 a month for Workers (cost.md, read 2026-11-06).
  • Approach A MySQL: you also pay for the database. A MYSQL=vultr box is $10 a month.
  • Workers for Platforms: $30 a month for two or more sites (WfP Paid $25 plus Workers Paid $5).
  • Plan limits table with Cloudflare source links: docs/guide/cost.md.
